cue: Wave one hand side to side (Hello / Hi)
description: The robot raises one arm to a visible position, then performs a repetitive side-to-side wrist motion, simulating a friendly 'hello' wave, before gently lowering the arm slightly.

cue: Raise one hand briefly (Greeting / Acknowledgement)
description: The robot arm quickly rises from a neutral position to a mid-to-high pose, holds momentarily to acknowledge or greet, then performs a small, quick settling movement to conclude the gesture.

cue: Bow slightly from the waist (Respect / Greeting)
description: The robot transitions from a neutral stance, then performs a deliberate, slight forward tilt, mimicking a bow from the waist to convey respect or as a formal greeting, before slowly regaining a composed posture.

cue: Extend one hand vertically forward as if offering a handshake (Asking for handshake)
description: The robot arm moves from a slightly retracted, mid-height position to extend forward and slightly upward with a vertical gripper, as if presenting a hand for a handshake, and then makes a subtle final extension before holding the offering pose.

cue: Move one hand up and down vertically as if shaking someone’s hand (Imitating handshake)
description: The robot extends its arm forward into a handshake-ready position with a vertically oriented gripper, then performs several quick up-and-down vertical movements to simulate the action of shaking someone's hand.

cue: Wrap both arms around yourself (Hug / Comfort)
description: The robot extends an arm forward, then sweeps it across its chest while curling inward to simulate wrapping its arms around itself for a comforting embrace.

cue: Bring fingertips to lips and blow outward (Blow a kiss)
description: The robot first positions its hand near its lips, then makes a subtle outward motion, simulating blowing a kiss, followed by a graceful extension of the arm.

cue: Form a big heart shape above head (Love)
description: The robot positions its arm high above its head, then traces a large, symmetrical heart shape in the air with a fluid motion, emphasizing the final point of the heart.

cue: Place one hand over chest (Sincerity / Gratitude)
description: The robot moves its arm to a mid-height, slightly forward position, then deliberately brings its hand over its chest, settling there with a horizontal palm to express sincerity or gratitude.

cue: Raise both fists upward (Victory / Excitement)
description: The robot swiftly raises its arm, as if clenching a fist, in a powerful upward thrust to signify victory or excitement, with a brief, energetic hold at the peak, followed by a slight celebratory quiver.

cue: Pump one fist downward (Success / Yes!)
description: The robot raises its arm to an overhead position, then executes a sharp, emphatic downward motion, typically signifying success, agreement, or confirmation.

cue: Flex one arm to show bicep (Strength)
description: The robot starts with its arm slightly extended to its side, then powerfully curls its forearm upwards to flex its bicep, holding the pose briefly to demonstrate strength, before a subtle, controlled release.

cue: Nod head up and down (Yes)
description: The robot positions its arm to a neutral, slightly forward stance (setup), then performs two clear, deliberate up-and-down tilts of the gripper (core action) to signal affirmation.

cue: Shake head side to side (No)
description: The robot arm moves to a position near its 'head' area with a vertical gripper, then performs a distinct side-to-side wrist motion, mimicking a head shake to indicate 'no'.

cue: Shrug shoulders with palms up (I don’t know)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm and shoulder, simultaneously rotating its hand to present the palm upwards and slightly outward, holding this posture to express uncertainty or 'I don't know'.

cue: Scratch head lightly (Confusion)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, positions the hand as if to scratch, performs a series of light scratching movements, and then slightly lowers the arm in a pensive manner, indicating confusion or deep thought.

cue: Tilt head slightly (Curiosity)
description: The robot arm moves to a neutral, slightly forward position as if engaged, then subtly shifts its 'head' (gripper) to the side with a slight tilt, indicating curiosity, and finally returns to the engaged posture.

cue: Place palm over face (Facepalm / Frustration)
description: The robot brings its hand up to cover its face with the palm, expressing frustration or exasperation, holding the position briefly before slowly lowering the arm.

cue: Point to chest with index finger (Me)
description: The robot raises its arm and moves its gripper, oriented vertically as if an index finger is extended, to point directly at its own chest, holds the pose to signal 'me' or 'I', then gently withdraws.

cue: Point forward with index finger (You)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the gripper tip pointing ahead, as if singling out an individual or direction, holding the gesture briefly for emphasis.

cue: Turn palm downward and curl fingers inward repeatedly (Come here / Beckon)
description: The robot extends its arm forward with the palm oriented horizontally (downward), then rapidly and repeatedly twists its wrist to simulate the 'come here' beckoning gesture with a flicking motion.
validation_warnings: Beckon cue should have a clear repeated core action with repetition 3-5

cue: Extend palm forward flat (Stop)
description: The robot quickly extends its arm forward with the palm flat and facing forward, holding this position to signal 'stop' or 'wait'.

cue: Raise index finger upright (One moment / Important point)
description: The robot raises its arm with the gripper oriented vertically, extending it upwards and holding to signal 'one moment' or emphasize an 'important point'.

cue: Place index finger on lips (Shh / Be quiet)
description: The robot's arm smoothly rises from a neutral position, pulls back towards its body, and bends at the elbow. Simultaneously, the wrist reorients, bringing the gripper's 'index finger' close to its 'lips'. It then holds this position firmly to convey a 'shh' or 'be quiet' gesture.

cue: Pat stomach lightly (Hungry / Full)
description: The robot brings its hand to the lower front region of its body, then makes a series of light, repetitive patting motions on its stomach, before slowly retracting its arm.

cue: Rub both upper arms (Cold)
description: The robot arm moves across its body, bringing the gripper to the position of the opposite upper arm, then performs a repetitive up-and-down motion to simulate rubbing for warmth, ending with a slight settling motion.

cue: Fan face with one hand (Hot)
description: The robot raises one arm to the side of its head, then moves its hand back and forth rapidly as if fanning itself due to heat, before slowly lowering the arm as the fanning subsides.

cue: Open mouth wide and cover it (Sleepy / Yawn)
description: The robot lowers its arm slightly in preparation for a yawn (setup), then stretches backward as if opening its 'mouth' wide, swiftly bringing its hand up to cover it (core action), before slowly lowering the hand and settling back into a relaxed posture (follow-through).

cue: Rub one eye (Tired)
description: The robot brings its hand to the side of its face near one eye, performs a gentle rubbing motion, and then slowly pulls back, conveying a sense of tiredness or sleepiness.

cue: Bow deeply while hands at sides (Apology)
description: The robot moves its arm to a low, neutral position at its side, then articulates its shoulder to lean forward and downward in a deep bow, holding the posture to convey a sincere apology.

cue: Raise both hands and flex index and middle fingers twice (Air quotes)
description: The robot raises its arm to chest height, points the gripper forward, and then makes two distinct 'quoting' gestures by flexing and unflexing its 'fingers' (wrist joint) twice in quick succession. This motion represents the 'air quotes' gesture, often used for emphasis or irony.

cue: Tap temple with index finger (Think / Smart)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, positions its gripper as if an index finger is extended, then performs a series of quick taps on its temple to signal 'thinking' or 'smart'.

cue: Rotate index finger near temple (Crazy)
description: The robot raises its arm to the side of its head, then traces small circles near the temple to signal 'crazy' or 'thinking too hard'.

cue: Slide index finger across lips like zipping (Secret / Won’t tell)
description: The robot raises its hand to the side of its mouth, brings it close, then quickly slides it horizontally across the lips as if 'zipping them shut' to signal secrecy or an unwillingness to reveal information.

cue: Cross arms over chest (Defensive)
description: The robot's arm moves from its side, sweeps across the front of its body as if crossing over the chest, and holds in a defensive posture, conveying disagreement, coldness, or a guarded stance.

cue: Place both hands on hips (Confidence / Annoyed)
description: The robot moves its arm from a neutral position to place the gripper firmly on its hip, simulating one side of a 'hands on hips' posture to convey confidence or mild annoyance. The motion ends with a subtle settling movement.

cue: Lean forward slightly with palms open (Interest)
description: The robot moves from a neutral position, subtly leans its torso and arm forward, and presents an open-palmed gesture to signal active interest or attentiveness.

cue: Step back slightly with both palms raised outward (Shock / Surprise)
description: The robot quickly retracts its arm and simultaneously raises its hand, positioning the palm to face outward in a sharp, startled reaction, then holds the posture of surprise.

cue: Cover mouth with palm (Gasp / Oops)
description: The robot's arm swiftly moves from a ready position to cover its mouth with its palm, conveying surprise or embarrassment, and holds the pose briefly.

cue: Press palms together and bow slightly (Thank you / Respect)
description: The robot moves its gripper to a central, vertical 'palms together' position near its chest. It then performs a slow, respectful bow from the shoulder, holding the bowed posture briefly before gracefully returning to a slightly lifted position.

cue: Raise one hand as if holding an invisible glass (Cheers)
description: The robot begins in a neutral position, then smoothly raises its arm as if holding a glass. It performs a slight forward tilt to offer a toast, holds briefly, and concludes with a subtle celebratory upward lift.

cue: Raise one palm upward as if inviting a high five (Asking for high five)
description: The robot extends its arm forward and slightly upward, presenting its palm flat for a high five. This involves an initial setup, a clear upward movement, a brief hold, and a subtle anticipatory bounce.

cue: Swing one raised palm downward as if high-fiving air (Imitating high five)
description: The robot raises its arm with an open, flat hand to an elevated position, then executes a swift, strong downward swing, as if making contact for a high five in mid-air, followed by a slight recoil and settling.

cue: Extend one fist forward (Asking for fist bump)
description: The robot starts from a neutral, slightly retracted position, then extends its arm decisively forward with the gripper tip pointing front to offer a fist bump, holding the pose briefly for recognition.

cue: Tap one fist lightly against your other palm (Imitating fist bump)
description: The robot positions its gripper, acting as a 'fist', near its own forearm to simulate tapping an open palm. It then executes a quick, light tap before retracting slightly.

cue: Pat your own back (Encouragement)
description: The robot reaches its arm behind its body, positions the gripper to simulate a hand, then executes a series of firm pats on its own back to convey self-encouragement.

cue: Draw a circle in the air with index finger (Repeat / Around)
description: The robot's arm moves to a comfortable mid-air position for drawing, then the wrist executes a continuous circular motion twice, simulating drawing a circle in the air.

cue: Slice flat hand horizontally across throat (Cut / Stop it)
description: The robot quickly raises its hand to the side of the throat, then performs a sharp, horizontal slicing motion across the throat area, signifying a command to stop or 'cut it out'.

cue: Swipe back of fingers outward from under chin (Dismissive / Whatever)
description: The robot positions its hand with the back of the fingers under the chin, then quickly swipes the hand outward and slightly upward in a dismissive gesture.

cue: Drum fingers on table or in air (Waiting / Bored)
description: The robot extends its arm slightly forward and positions its gripper flat as if over a surface, then rapidly oscillates its wrist up and down to simulate drumming fingers, concluding with a slight, languid lateral shift of the arm.

cue: Turn palm upward and curl fingers inward (Give me)
description: The robot extends its arm slightly forward, then rotates its wrist to present the palm upwards. From this 'palm up' position, it performs a rapid, subtle inward flexion of the wrist, mimicking a beckoning or 'give me' gesture.

cue: Extend open palm upward steadily (Offering)
description: The robot arm starts in a neutral, slightly forward position, then smoothly extends upward and forward while opening its palm, presenting a clear offering or invitation. The motion concludes with a deliberate hold, emphasizing the gesture.

cue: Raise both hands beside head (I give up / Surrender)
description: The robot quickly raises its arm to a high, open-handed position beside its head, with the gripper opening facing forward, holding the pose briefly to signify 'giving up' or 'surrender'.

cue: Cover both ears (Too loud / Don’t want to hear)
description: The robot quickly raises one arm, positioning its gripper over the side of its head (simulating covering an ear) and holding the pose to convey being overwhelmed by noise or not wanting to listen. This motion applies to a single arm, implying the other would mirror if a dual-arm setup were available.

cue: Open both arms wide outward (Welcome)
description: The robot extends its arm from a neutral mid-position, moving it outward, slightly upward, and less forward, simulating an open, welcoming gesture as if to embrace. The gripper is held horizontally.

cue: Stretch both arms upward (Relief / Stretch)
description: The robot slowly raises its arm high above its head, extends fully as if stretching, and holds the position, conveying a sense of relief or a good, deep stretch after being sedentary.

cue: Bring one hand to forehead in salute position (Salute)
description: The robot arm quickly raises and bends, bringing its gripper to the forehead in a crisp, vertical salute, holding the position briefly.

cue: Place one hand above eyebrows as visor and look far (Searching distance)
description: The robot starts in a ready, neutral posture, then raises its arm and positions its hand above its 'eyebrows' like a visor. It holds this pose while subtly scanning the horizon from left to right, mimicking a search.
